response.rationale: The query describes the same causal failure as this workflow: a premature stream termination is not recognized by the retry classifier, so the established retry path is never selected. The workflow repairs that classifier narrowly and validates that an iteration-time stream failure triggers bounded retry and permits a later complete response. Applicability is conditional because the query does not establish the concrete proxy error identity or the target repository's retry architecture.
missing_preconditions: Confirm the proxy termination exposes a stable error code or equivalent reliably classifiable signal.
Confirm the existing bounded retry mechanism handles exceptions raised during stream iteration.
Confirm replaying the streamed operation is safe and will not duplicate externally visible side effects.
Confirm the termination was not caused by caller cancellation or abort.
Confirm a regression can reproduce the premature ending and provide a successful subsequent attempt.
